title: Fake Patients
summary: Three people in a taco truck queue each claim a symptom, and V has to pick the one who is lying.
description: Three people in a taco truck queue in the Glen each claim one symptom, and only one of them is lying. Viktor has invited V to the lot to work out who.

start.bringUp: Viktor invites V to the taco truck lot in the Glen, where three people in the queue claim one symptom each and only one of them is lying.

variations.know: The faker is a runner dodging a debt.
All three are honest, and the trap is trying to find a liar.
V plays the patient and Viktor guesses which of the three is the faker.

lot.name: the taco truck lot in the Glen

queue.name: the queue at the taco truck

g1.asks: Who did you pick, and what made you doubt the other two?
g1.know: The three claims, and the true story.
g1.secret: He knew in the first minute.
g1.wants: V to say how he questioned them.

g2.asks: Do you tell him you know?
g2.know: The twist: the faker is the sickest of the three and hides it because he cannot pay.
g2.secret: He has done it both ways and regrets both.

stages.label: V questions three people in the taco truck queue
stages.objective: Question the three people in the taco truck queue for Viktor
stages.know: Viktor waits on the side of the lot while you talk to three people in the queue. Each claims a symptom. One of them is a faker, and the sickest of the three may be the one hiding it.
stages.wants: V to pick the faker and to see who needs help.

choices.means: V names the faker and says how he questioned the other two.

done.memory: You questioned three people in the Glen queue, picked one, and told Viktor how you knew.

paid.memory: You paid for a stranger's treatment at a taco truck in the Glen, and Viktor did not say a word about it.
